items.title: 53571_Mary Lou Williams oral history interview
items.q: I happened to be at a party that Lascelles, you know, he's the Queen's cousin, he gave a party for Garland Wilson and I.

ctx.x: praying was before I left England the Queen's cousin Lascelles follows jazz and he gave a party. I must have looked disturbed because there was one other black person, a GI. He says, "You seem like you're disturbed. My grandmother always said to read the 91st Psalm." I've never been able to drink at one time over two drinks without really getting high, so I thought he said read all the Psalms so I went home and started reading them all. Seemed like that just turned me around and started me to praying.
Just coming out of you now. Was this before you left England?
